title: fleetmon capacity feed, consumed read-only by fleetqd (REFINED_PLAN §7)
description: Raw per-GPU samples with their own identity, time and boot. A response's generation time is NOT a sample time; fleetqd builds idle windows only from distinct sample_ids. Additive changes only within v1.

generated_at.description: When fleetmon built this response (epoch s). Never used as a sample time.

samples.description: Recent samples, oldest first, from at least the last 180 s, including polls the hub's history thinning would drop. fleetq's idle rule needs samples no more than ~65 s apart, so shared hosts should be polled every 30 s or faster.

sample_id.description: The fleetmon poll id: stable per poll, so a cached re-read is never a new observation

sample_time.description: When the hub received the measurement (epoch s, on the hub's clock, within one poll round-trip of the measurement), so a skewed host clock cannot make old data look fresh. Never the response's generated_at.

supported.description: NVML answered for this GPU and every required metric was read

complete.description: The GPU's NVML compute-process count is trustworthy: supported, no GPU error, not MIG-partitioned. Hidden or truncated host process tables do not affect it.

process_count.description: NVML compute processes on this GPU; null when not supported (unknown is never zero)

mem_used_mib.description: Device memory in use, MiB (not bytes); null when not supported

utilization.description: GPU utilization, percent 0-100 (not a 0-1 fraction); null when not supported
